activities.note: Walk down directly from Kiyomizu-dera onto the historic stone-paved pedestrian alleys of Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka. Pass the famous Yasaka Pagoda (Hokan-ji), traditional pottery shops, and wooden machiya cafes (20 min walk, 1.2km).

activities.note: Walk through the serene pine path to Kyoko-chi (Mirror Pond). Marvel at the top two floors completely covered in brilliant gold leaf shimmering on the reflective water in winter afternoon light. Stroll through the tea garden and stone pagoda path.

activities.transitSummary: Walk 5 min back to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa
activities.note: Walk 5 min back to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa. Rest well for Tokyo city exploration tomorrow!

theme: 🦖 Godzilla Head Shinjuku → ⚡ Akihabara Tech Shopping → 🛍️ Ameyoko Thrifting

hotel.name: Tokyo Hotel (Final Night)
hotel.notes: Organize baggage & tax-free shopping receipts for tomorrow's airport check-in

activities.title: Hotel Tavinos Asakusa ➔ Shinjuku Kabukicho
activities.stationWalk: Oedo Line to Shinjuku-nishiguchi Exit D3 ➔ Walk 5 min (400m) to Gracery
activities.transitSummary: Subway to Shinjuku (22 min, ¥280) ➔ Walk 5 min through Kabukicho
activities.note: Walk 6 min to Asakusa Station ➔ Board Toei Asakusa Line 1 stop to Kuramae, transfer to Toei Oedo Line to Shinjuku-nishiguchi Station (22 min, ¥280) ➔ Take Exit D3, walk 5 min (400m) east through vibrant Kabukicho pedestrian arcade to Hotel Gracery Shinjuku.

activities.title: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku (Godzilla Head Photo Stop)
activities.stationWalk: Take elevator to 8F lobby terrace (5 min walk from Shinjuku East Exit)
activities.transitSummary: Life-sized roaring Godzilla Head terrace photo stop
activities.note: Take elevator to 8F lobby terrace of Hotel Gracery Shinjuku. Stand face-to-face with the life-sized, roaring Godzilla Head roaring over the Shinjuku skyline (roars with smoke and red light effects on the hour!).

activities.title: Shinjuku ➔ Akihabara (JR Chuo-Sobu Line)
activities.stationWalk: Platform 13/16 at Shinjuku ➔ 14 min direct to Akihabara Electric Town Exit
activities.transitSummary: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (14 min direct, ¥180 / ~RM 5 pp)
activities.note: Walk 5 min south to JR Shinjuku Station ➔ Enter Central Ticket Gate, go to Platform 13/16 ➔ Board JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Yellow Line) direct to JR Akihabara Station (14 min, 7 stops, ¥180 / ~RM 5 pp). Exit via Electric Town Exit (Denki-gai Gate)!

activities.title: Akihabara Electric Town & Yodobashi-Akiba
activities.transitMethod: Walk (1 min from Electric Town Exit!)
activities.stationWalk: Step directly out from Electric Town Exit into Yodobashi & arcades (1 min)
activities.transitSummary: Walk 1 min directly from Electric Town Exit into Yodobashi
activities.note: Step directly out from Electric Town Exit into Radio Kaikan, Mandarake, and Animate anime/gaming towers. Walk 1 min across the plaza into Yodobashi Camera Multimedia Akiba (9 massive floors of electronics, camera lenses, noise-canceling headphones, handheld consoles, and duty-free tech).

activities.title: Don Quijote Akihabara (Souvenirs & Tax-Free)
activities.stationWalk: Walk 4 min (300m) north along Chuo-dori avenue
activities.transitSummary: Walk 4 min (300m) north along Chuo-dori to Donki
activities.note: Walk 4 min (300m) north along main Chuo-dori avenue to Don Quijote Akihabara (5 floors of discount Japanese snacks, matcha KitKats, cosmetics, skincare, novelty goods, and duty-free checkout on top floor).

activities.title: Ameyoko Shopping Street & Ueno Park (Thrifting & Bargains)
activities.stationWalk: Walk 10 min north along rail arches straight into Ameyoko (1 min from Okachimachi)
activities.transitSummary: Walk 10 min north along rail arches into Ameyoko market
activities.note: Walk north 10–12 min (800m) along the elevated JR railway arches straight into the south entrance of Ameyoko Shopping Street at Okachimachi Station (or take JR Yamanote Line 1 stop, 2 min, ¥150). Hunt for vintage Japanese streetwear, sneakers, jacket thrifting, dried seafood, and stroll into Ueno Park.

activities.title: Farewell Halal Dinner: HALAL SAKURA
activities.stationWalk: Ginza Line 3 stops from Ueno to Asakusa (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk 8 min
activities.transitSummary: Subway Ginza Line 5 min to Asakusa ➔ Walk 8 min to dinner
activities.note: Walk 2 min to Tokyo Metro Ueno Station ➔ Board Ginza Line 3 stops direct to Asakusa Station (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk 8 min to HALAL SAKURA for farewell dinner.

activities.title: Return to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa (Pack Luggage)
activities.stationWalk: Walk 5 min back to Hotel Tavinos Base
activities.transitSummary: Walk 5 min back to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa
activities.note: Walk 5 min back to Hotel Tavinos Asakusa. Weigh and pack suitcases for departure tomorrow!

theme: 🧳 Final Souvenirs → Skyliner Express → Narita Airport 16:50 Flight ✈️

hotel.name: Tokyo Hotel
hotel.notes: Luggage check-out and transfer to Narita International Airport

activities.title: Check out Hotel Tavinos Asakusa ➔ Keisei Ueno Station
activities.stationWalk: Ginza Line 3 stops to Ueno (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Underground walkway (3 min) to Keisei Ueno
activities.transitSummary: Subway 5 min to Ueno ➔ Walkway 3 min to Keisei Ueno
activities.note: Check out Hotel Tavinos Asakusa by 10:00am. Walk 6 min to Tokyo Metro Asakusa Station ➔ Board Ginza Line 3 stops to Ueno Station (5 min, ¥180) ➔ Walk through indoor underground connection (3 min, 180m) to Keisei Ueno Station (Skyliner Terminal).

activities.title: Early Lunch & Souvenir Browsing near Ueno
activities.stationWalk: Stroll 2 min into Ueno 3153 dining complex or Ameyoko entrance
activities.transitSummary: Walk 2 min into Ueno dining complex / station concourse
activities.note: Store bags in Keisei Ueno station coin lockers or keep luggage roll in hand. Stroll 2 min into Ueno 3153 dining complex or Ameyoko entrance for coffee and early lunch.

activities.title: Keisei Skyliner Express (Keisei Ueno ➔ Narita Airport)
activities.stationWalk: Board Platform 1/2 at Keisei Ueno ➔ 41 min non-stop to Narita Terminal 1 concourse
activities.transitSummary: Keisei Skyliner (41 min non-stop, 160 km/h, ¥2,570 pp)
activities.note: Enter Skyliner Gates at Keisei Ueno Station (Platform 1/2). Board Keisei Skyliner Express (12:40 departure). Race across the Chiba plain at 160 km/h on the Narita Sky Access Line — non-stop to Narita Airport Terminal 2·3 Station (36 min) and Terminal 1 Station (41 min) (¥2,570 / ~RM 75 pp).

activities.title: Narita International Airport (Check-in & Duty-Free)
activities.stationWalk: Take elevators from station platforms directly up to 4F Departures
activities.transitSummary: Elevators connect station platform directly to 4F Departures
activities.note: Take elevators from station platforms directly up to 4F International Departures concourse. Check in luggage at airline counters (Batik Air / Malaysia Airlines / AirAsia X). Clear security and automated immigration gates (approx 45 min). Browse terminal duty-free boutiques (Tokyo Banana, Royce' Chocolate, Shiroi Koibito cookies, Japanese tea).

activities.title: Boarding & Flight Departure (NRT ➔ KUL)
activities.stationWalk: Proceed to departure gate by 16:15 for 16:50 flight
activities.transitSummary: Proceed to departure gate for 16:50 flight home
activities.note: Proceed to departure gate by 16:15. Board aircraft for flight departure at 16:50 back to Kuala Lumpur (KUL). Touchdown safe and sound with unforgettable winter memories!
